title: Tenant Care Desk Ruling: Number of Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plans per Agreement and per Tenant
content:
A tenant may hold one Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan for each storage unit or parking agreement, with no cap on the number of agreements covered. An agreement may have only one plan in pending payment or active status. A follow-on plan bought in the renewal window starts the day after the current term ends.

## The ruling in parts

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What does one plan cover? | One storage unit rental agreement or one parking agreement. |
| How many agreements of one tenant may be covered? | No limit: there is no cap on the number of agreements a tenant covers with plans. |
| How many plans may one agreement have at a time? | One plan in pending payment or active status. |
| Which plan statuses count toward that one? | Pending payment and active. |
| When does a follow-on plan bought in the renewal window start? | On the day after the current term ends. |

The count is taken per agreement from the company's plan records for that agreement, before the purchase is made; the tenant's own account of what plans exist is not the basis.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical tenants)

- A tenant with three storage units and one boat space may have four plans at once, one on each agreement; the number of agreements covered is not limited.
- An agreement whose earlier plan is completed, ended early, forfeited or cancelled has no plan in pending payment or active status on that account; the earlier plan does not count toward the one.
- An agreement that already shows a plan in pending payment status cannot take a further plan in pending payment or active status alongside it.
- Two plans on two different agreements of the same tenant are judged separately; a plan on one agreement does not count toward the limit of another.
- A follow-on plan bought in the renewal window of a plan whose term ends on 30 June starts on 1 July (hypothetical dates).
